claim_boundary: This is an ordinary characteristic-zero zero-intersection theorem for the first positive factor-span excess. It does not prove a new exact Chow rank, optimize all finite-n numerical bounds, improve border rank or establish literature novelty.

theorem.closed_range: For m>=3, q>=2 and q*n<=m^2+1, every q-term Chow block has zero intersection with D_m(perm_n).
theorem.zero_block: zeta_plus(n,m)=floor((m^2+1)/n), for m>=3 when the displayed quotient is at least two.
